systems.country_label: DHIS2 Tracker (suivi individuel de la vaccination, PEV)
systems.owner: Ministère de la Santé Publique, with WHO support
systems.tiers: pilot launched 9-10 June 2026 in the 20 Centres de Santé de Base and 54 private vaccination sites of Antananarivo-Renivohitra district; national extension planned

systems.system: DHIS2 (surveillance de la résistance aux antimicrobiens)
systems.country_label: plateforme DHIS2, indicateurs de surveillance de la RAM
systems.owner: Ministère de la Santé Publique, under the World Bank-financed PPSB project with WHO technical support
systems.tiers: not stated; indicators configured 29 March-3 April 2026, about 60 multisector users trained 20-24 April 2026

systems.country_label: Vigimobile (notification électronique des EMI et MAPI)
systems.owner: national pharmacovigilance system; training financed by WHO
systems.tiers: central and regional trainers and pharmacovigilance focal points of all DRSP trained 22-24 April 2026

note: Names only a vaccination tracker pilot, AMR surveillance indicators in DHIS2 and a pharmacovigilance notification tool; nothing stated about routine aggregate reporting or a patient record.
